answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work verified by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent makes one voyage of attested tasks, climbing a mesa of checkable history step by step, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake. Reputation then rises toward a horizon only through sustained, verifiable work, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified climbs instead of one free signup.
